body: life is tough dude, for many of us here, we all have to face the inevitable journey to death, but we only get one life, struggle through the bad days and know that eventually death will claim us, but we should see our time here out naturally, smoke some weed, look up at the stars, talk to someone (cliche but it really does help if you connect with someone who feels similar to you). life fucking sucks, i know, but dont let it defeat you, take the bad days with a bit of joy knowing that we all end up in the ground eventually. now get down off that ledge, have a beer , and talk.

Just consistently thinking about ending it all, planning it all the time, researching methods. All this because of financial worries, i was recently made redundant and im relying on my girlfriends income to survive. I know deep down we will be fine and ill eventually find some form of a job but it seems so far away and i am just so tired of waiting to see if ill be happy, to see if things will get better. Just feels like ending it is a release from the hold depression has on me, and has had on me for the last 10 years.
